title: Salawaat of Holy Prophet (sawa)
description: Salawaat upon the Holy Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him and his family).

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا حَمَلَ وَحْيَكَ وَبَلَّغَ رِسَالاتِكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin kama hamala wahyaka wa ballagha risalatika
lines.english: O Allah, (please) bless Muhammad as he bore Your revelations and conveyed Your messages.

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَحَلَّ حَلالَكَ وَحَرَّمَ حَرامَكَ وَعَلَّمَ كِتَابَكَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin kama ahalla halalaka wa harrama haramaka wa `allama kitabaka
lines.english: And (please) bless Muhammad as he declared lawful that which You deemed lawful, forbade that which You deemed unlawful, and taught Your Book (to people).

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَقَامَ الصَّلاةَ وَآتَى الزَّكَاةَ وَدَعَا إِلَىٰ دِينِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin kama aqama alssalata wa ata alzzakata wa da`a ila dinika
lines.english: And (please) bless Muhammad as he performed the prayers, defrayed the poor-rate, and called to Your religion.

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَدَّقَ بِوَعْدِكَ وَأَشْفَقَ مِنْ وَعِيدِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin kama saddaqa biwa`dika wa ashfaqa min wa`idika
lines.english: And (please) bless Muhammad for he gave credence to Your promise and feared Your threat.

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا غَفَرْتَ بِهِ الذُّنُوبَ وَسَتَرْتَ بِهِ الْعُيُوبَ وَفَرَّجْتَ بِهِ الْكُرُوبَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin kama ghafarta bihi aldhdhunuba wa satarta bihi al`uyuba wa farrajta bihi alkuruba
lines.english: And (please) bless Muhammad as You, for his sake, forgave sins, concealed defects, and relieved agonies.

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا دَفَعْتَ بِهِ الشَّقَاءَ وَكَشَفْتَ بِهِ الْغَمَّاءَ وَأَجَبْتَ بِهِ الدُّعَاءَ وَنَجَّيْتَ بِهِ مِنَ الْبَلاءِ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin kama dafa`ta bihi alshshaqa'a wa kashafta bihi alghamma‘a wa ajabta bihi alddu`a'a wa najjayta bihi min albala'i
lines.english: And (please) bless Muhammad as You, for his sake, warded off misery, relieved grievances, responded to prayers, and saved from misfortunes.

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا رَحِمْتَ بِهِ الْعِبَادَ وَأَحْيَيْتَ بِهِ الْبِلادَ وَقَصَمْتَ بِهِ الْجَبَابِرَةَ وَأَهْلَكْتَ بِهِ الْفَرَاعِنَةَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin kama rahimta bihi al`ibada wa ahyayta bihi albilada wa qasamta bihi aljababirata wa ahlakta bihi alfara`inata
lines.english: And (please) bless Muhammad as You, for his sake, had mercy on the servants, restored lands into life, trashed the tyrants, and obliterated the despots.

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَضْعَفْتَ بِهِ الأَمْوَالَ وَأَحْرَزْتَ بِهِ مِنَ الأَهْوَالِ وَكَسَرْتَ بِهِ الأَصْنَامَ وَرَحِمْتَ بِهِ الأَنَامَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin kama ad`afta bihi al-amwala wa ahrazta bihi min al-ahwali wa kasarta bihi al-asnama wa rahimta bihi al-anama
lines.english: And (please) bless Muhammad as You, for his sake, multiplied fortunes, protected against terrors, broke the idols, and had mercy upon the human beings.

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَعَثْتَهُ بِخَيْرِ الأَدْيَانِ وَأَعْزَزْتَ بِهِ الإِيمَانَ وَتَبَّرْتَ بِهِ الأَوْثَانَ وَعَظَّمْتَ بِهِ الْبَيْتَ الْحَرَامَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin kama ba`athtahu bikhayri al-adyani wa a`zazta bihi al-imana wa tabbarta bihi al-awthana wa `azzamta bihi albayta alharama
lines.english: And (please) bless Muhammad as You sent him with the best of all religions, strengthened the faith through him, broke into pieces the idols though him, and poured tribute on the Holy House.

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الطَّاهِرِينَ الأَخْيَارِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيماً
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin wa ahli baytihi alttahirina al-akhyari wa sallim tasliman
lines.english: And (please) bless Muhammad and his Household the immaculate and virtuous and send thorough benedictions on them.

title: Salawaat of Imam Ali (as)
description: Salawaat upon the Commander of the Faithful, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him).

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala amiri almu'minina `ali bni abi talibin
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon the Commander of the Faithful Ali the son of Abu-Talib,

lines.transliteration: akhi nabiyyika wa waliyihi wa safiyyihi wa wazirihi
lines.english: the brother, ally, choice, and patron of Your Prophet,

lines.arabic: وَمُسْتَوْدَعِ عِلْمِهِ وَمَوْضِعِ سِرِّهِ وَبَابِ حِكْمَتِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa mustawda`i `ilmihi wa mawdi`i sirrihi wa babi hikmatihi
lines.english: the store of his knowledge, the depot of his secrets, and the door to his wisdom,

lines.arabic: وَالنَّاطِقِ بِحُجَّتِهِ وَالدَّاعِي إِلَىٰ شَرِيعَتِهِ وَخَلِيفَتِهِ فِي أُمَّتِهِ
lines.transliteration: walnnatiqi bihujjatihi waldda`i ila shari`atihi wa khalifatihi fi ummatihi
lines.english: the spokesman with his arguments, the caller to his code of law, and his viceroy in his community,

lines.arabic: وَمُفَرِّجِ الْكُرُوبِ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ وَقَاصِمِ الْكَفَرَةِ وَمُرْغِمِ الْفَجَرَةِ
lines.transliteration: wa mufarriji alkurabi `an wajhihi wa qasimi alkafarati wa murghimi alfajarati
lines.english: the reliever of agonies from his face, the terminator of the infidels, and the conqueror on the wicked ones;

lines.arabic: الَّذِي جَعَلْتَهُ مِنْ نَبِيِّكَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَىٰ
lines.transliteration: alladhi ja`altahu min nabiyyika bimanzilati haruna min musa
lines.english: You have made him, with regard to his position to Your Prophet, occupy the same position that Aaron enjoyed with Moses.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَالِ مَنْ وَالاهُ وَعَادِ مَنْ عَادَاهُ
lines.transliteration: allahumma wali man walahu wa `adi man `adahu
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) give support to any one who supports him, be the enemy of every one who antagonizes him,

lines.arabic: وَانْصُرْ مَنْ نَصَرَهُ وَاخْذُلْ مَنْ خَدَلَهُ
lines.transliteration: wansur man nasarahu wakhdhul man khadhalahu
lines.english: give victory to any one who gives him his victory, disappoint every one who disappoints him,

lines.arabic: وَالْعَنْ مَنْ نَصَبَ لَهُ مِنَ الأَهْوَلِينَ وَالآخِرِينَ
lines.transliteration: wal`an man nasaba lahu min al-awwalina wal-akhirina
lines.english: and lay curse on any one who incurs the hostility of him from the past and the coming generations.

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَوْصِيَاءِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `alayhi afdala ma sallayta `ala ahadin min awsiya'i anbiya'ika ya rabba al`alamina
lines.english: And (please do) bless him with the best blessings that You have ever poured on any of Your Prophet’s successors, O Lord of the worlds!

title: Salawaat of Lady Fatima (sa)
description: Salawaat upon the Leader of the Women of Paradise, Lady Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her).

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ الصِّدِّيقَةِ فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاءِ
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon the truthful Fatima al-Zahra’,
the daughter of Your Prophet, the wife of Your ally,

lines.arabic: وَأُمِّ السِّبْطَيْنِ الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ سَيِّدَيْ شَبَابِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ
lines.transliteration: wa ummi alssibtayni alhasani walhusayni sayyiday shababi ahli al-jannati
lines.english: and the mother of the two grandsons—al-Hasan and al-Husayn, the two masters of the youth of Paradise.
The pure, immaculate, purified, pious, and clean,

lines.arabic: الرَّضِيَّةِ الزَّكِيَّةِ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَاءِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ أَجْمَعِينَ
lines.transliteration: alrradiyyati alzzakiyyati sayyidati nisa'i ahli al-jannati ajma`ina
lines.english: satisfied, and virtuous; the doyenne of all women of Paradise.

lines.arabic: صَلاةً لا يَقْوَىٰ عَلَىٰ إِحْصَائِهَا غَيْرُكَ
lines.english: Blessings that none can count save You.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ كُنِ الطَّالِبَ لَهَا مِمَّنْ ظَلَمَهَا
lines.transliteration: allahumma kun alttaliba laha mimman zalamaha
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) take her side against those who wronged her,

lines.arabic: وَاسْتَخَفَّ بِحَقِّهَا وَكُنِ الثَّائِرَ اللَّهُمَّ بِدَمِ أَوْلادِهَا
lines.transliteration: wastakhaffa bihaqqiha wa kun alththa'ira allahumma bidami awladiha
lines.english: disregarded her right, and be the seeker of the blood of her children.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَكَمَا جَعَلْتَهَا سَيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa kama ja`altaha sayyidata nisa'i ahli al-jannati
lines.english: O Allah, just as You have made her the doyenne of the women of Paradise,
so also (please do) make her our intercessor on the Day of Resurrection.
And (please do) bless her with blessings that are permanent and everlasting.

title: Salawaat of Imam Hasan & Hussain (as)
description: Salawaat upon the two masters of the youth of Paradise, Imam al-Hasan and Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon them).

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ الْحَسَنِ وَالْحُسَيْنِ عَبْدَيْكَ وَوَلِيَّيْكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala alhasani walhusayni `abdayka wa waliyyayka
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon al-Hasan and al-Husayn, Your two servants and allies,

lines.arabic: وَابْنَيْ رَسُولِكَ وَسِبْطَيِ الرَّحْمَةِ وَسَيِّدَيْ شَبَابِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ
lines.transliteration: wabnay rasulika wa sibty alrrahmati wa sayyiday shababi ahli al-jannati
lines.english: the two sons of Your Messenger, the two grandsons of (the Prophet of) mercy, and the two masters of the youth of Paradise.

lines.arabic: أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَوْلادِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالْمُرْسَلِينَ
lines.transliteration: afdala ma sallayta `ala ahadin min awladi alnnabiyyina walmursalina
lines.english: Best blessings that You have ever poured on any of the children of the Prophets and Messengers.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ الْحَسَنِ ابْنِ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala alhasani bni amiri almu'minina
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon al-Hasan, the son of the Commander of the Faithful,
and the son of the Messenger of the Lord of the worlds.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الْمَظْلُومِ الشَّهِيدِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala alhusayni bni `aliyyin almazlumi alshshahidi
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon al-Husayn the son of `Ali, the wronged and martyr,
the victim of tears and the captive of agonies.
Blessings through which bosoms are delighted,

lines.arabic: وَتَخْضَعُ لَهَا الرِّقَابُ وَتَقَرُّ بِهَا الأَعْيُنُ
lines.transliteration: wa takhda`u laha alrriqabu wa taqarru biha al-a`yunu
lines.english: necks are submissive, and eyes are comforted.

lines.transliteration: allahumma najjina mimma nakhafu wa nahdharu
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) save us from that which we fear and of which we are cautious.
By their right, O Lord of the worlds!

title: Salawaat of Imam Sajjad (as)
description: Salawaat upon the ornament of the worshippers, Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn Zain al-Abidin (as).

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ سَيِّدِ الْعَابِدِينَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala `aliyyi bni alhusayni sayyidi al`abidina
lines.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon `Ali the son of al-Husayn, the master of the worshippers,

lines.arabic: الَّذِي اسْتَخْلَصْتَهُ لِنَفْسِكَ وَجَعَلْتَ مِنْهُ أَئِمَّةَ الْهُدَىٰ
lines.transliteration: alladhi istakhlastahu linafsika wa ja`alta minhu a'immate alhuda
lines.english: whom You have purely dedicated to Yourself and brought forth from him the leaders of true guidance,

lines.transliteration: alladhina yahduna bilhaqqi wa bihi ya`diluna
lines.english: who guide to the truth and judge with it.

lines.transliteration: ikhtartahu linafsika wa tahhartahu min alrrijsi
lines.english: You have chosen him for Yourself, purified him against filth,
selected him, and made him guide and well-guided.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma fasalli `alayhi afdala ma sallayta `ala ahadin min dhurriyati anbiya'ika
lines.english: O Allah, send blessings upon him with the best blessings that You have ever poured on any of Your Prophets’ offspring,

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ بِهِ مَا تَقَرُّ بِهِ عَيْنُهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ
lines.transliteration: hatta yablugha bihi ma taqarr bihi `aynuhu fid dunya wal-akhirati
lines.english: so that these blessings raise him to what delights his eye in this world and the hereafter.
Verily, You are Almighty and All-wise.

title: Salawaat of Imam Baqir (as)
description: Salawaat upon the splitter of knowledge, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon him).

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ بَاقِرِ الْعِلْمِ وَإِمَامِ الْهُدَىٰ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadi bni `aliyyin baqiri al`ilmi wa imami alhuda
lines.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Muhammad the son of `Ali, the splitter of knowledge, the leader to true guidance,

lines.arabic: وَقَائِدِ أَهْلِ التَّقْوَىٰ وَالْمُنْتَجَبِ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa qa'idi ahli alttaqwa walmuntajabi min `ibadika
lines.english: the chief of the people of piety, and the chosen from among Your servants.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَكَمَا جَعَلْتَهُ عَلَماً لِعِبَادِكَ وَمَنَاراً لِبِلادِكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa kama ja`altahu `alaman li`ibadika wa manaran libiladika
lines.english: O Allah, as You have made him sign for Your servants, lantern in Your lands,

lines.arabic: وَمُسْتَوْدَعاً لِحِكْمَتِكَ وَمُتَرْجِماً لِوَحْيِكَ وَأَمَرْتَ بِطَاعَتِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa mustawda`an lihikmatika wa mutarjiman liwahyika wa amarta bita`atih
lines.english: depot of Your wisdom, interpreter of Your revelations, and You ordered (us) to obey him,

lines.arabic: وَحَذَّرْتَ عَنْ مَعْصِيَتِهِ فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ يَا رَبِّ
lines.transliteration: wa hadhdharta `an ma`siyatihi fasalli `alayhi ya rabbi
lines.english: and You warned (us) against disobeying him; so also (please), O Lord, send blessings upon him,

lines.arabic: أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّةِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَأَصْفِيَائِكَ
lines.transliteration: afdala ma sallayta `ala ahadin min dhurriyyati anbiya'ika wa asfiya'ika
lines.english: with the best blessings that You have ever poured on any of Your Prophets’ offspring and Your chosen ones,

lines.transliteration: wa rusulika wa umana'ika ya rabba al`alamin
lines.english: Your Messengers, and Your trustees, O Lord of the worlds!

title: Salawaat of Imam Sadiq (as)
description: Salawaat upon the truthful, Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq (peace be upon him).

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الصَّادِقِ خَازِنِ الْعِلْمِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala ja`fari bni muhammadin alssadiqi khazini al`ilmi
lines.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon Ja`far the son of Muhammad, the truthful, the treasurer of knowledge,
the caller to You with truth, and the manifest light.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَكَمَا جَعَلْتَهُ مَعْدِنَ كَلامِكَ وَوَحْيِكَ وَخَازِنَ عِلْمِكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa kama ja`altahu ma`dina kalamika wa wahyika wa khazina `ilmika
lines.english: O Allah, as You have made him the core of Your Word and Your revelation, the treasurer of Your knowledge,

lines.arabic: وَلِسَانَ تَوْحِيدِكَ وَوَلِيَّ أَمْرِكَ وَمُفْتَرَضَ طَاعَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa lisana tawhidika wa waliyya amrika wa muftarada bita`atika
lines.english: the tongue of Your Oneness, the authority of Your affair, and the mandated obedience to him,

lines.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ يَا رَبِّ أَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَصْفِيَائِكَ وَحُجَجِكَ
lines.transliteration: fasalli `alayhi ya rabbi afdala ma sallayta `ala ahadin min asfiya'ika wa hujajika
lines.english: so also (please), O Lord, send blessings upon him with the best blessings that You have ever poured on any of Your chosen ones and Your arguments,
O Lord of the worlds!

title: Salawaat of Imam Musa al-Kadhim (as)
description: Salawaat upon the restrainer of anger, Imam Musa ibn Ja'far al-Kadhim (peace be upon him).

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ الْأَمِينِ الْمُؤْتَمَنِ مُوسَىٰ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala al-amini almu'tamani musa bni ja`farin
lines.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings upon the honest and trusted Musa the son of Ja`far,

lines.arabic: الْبَرِّ الْوَفِيِّ الطَّاهِرِ الزَّكِيِّ النُّورِ الْمُبِينِ
lines.transliteration: albarri alwafiyyi alttahiri alzzakiyyi alnnuri almubini
lines.english: the dutiful, the faithful, the pure, the bright, the manifest light,

lines.arabic: الُمجْتَهِدِ الُْمحْتَسِبِ الصَّابِرِ عَلَىٰ الْأَذَىٰ فِيكَ
lines.english: the striver, the seeker of Your rewards, and the bearer of harm for Your sake.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَكَمَا بَلَّغَ عَنْ آبَائِهِ مَا اسْتُوِدِعَ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ وَنَهْيِكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa kama ballagha `an aba'ihi ma istudi`a min amrika wa nahyika
lines.english: O Allah, as he conveyed on the authority of his fathers all Your orders and prohibitions that were deposited with him,

lines.arabic: وَحَمَلَ عَلَىٰ الْمَحَجَّةِ وَكَاَبَدَ أَهْلَ الْعِزَّةِ وَالشِّدَّةِ
lines.transliteration: wa hamala `ala almahajjati wa kabada ahla al`izzati walshshiddati
lines.english: directed (people) to the clear course, and had to encounter the people of authority and persecution,

lines.arabic: فِيمَا كَانَ يَلْقَىٰ مِنْ جُهَّالِ قَوْمِهِ
lines.transliteration: fima kana yalqa min juhhali qawmihi
lines.english: while he was facing troubles from the ignorant people,

lines.arabic: رَبِّ فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ أَفْضَلَ وَأَكْمَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِمَّنْ أَطَاعَكَ
lines.transliteration: rabbi fasalli `alayhi afdala wa akmala ma sallayta `ala ahadin mimman ata`aka
lines.english: so, O Lord, bless him with the most favorite and most perfect blessings that You have ever conferred upon anyone who obeyed You

lines.transliteration: wa nasaha li`ibadika innaka ghafurun rahimun
lines.english: and wished well for Your servants. Verily, You are All-forgiving, All-merciful.

title: Salawaat of Imam Ali al-Ridha (as)
description: Salawaat upon the pleased, Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha (peace be upon him).

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسَىٰ الرِّضَا الْمُرْتَضَىٰ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala `aliyyi bni musa alrrida almurtada
lines.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon `Ali the son of Musa, the pleased, the well-liked,

lines.arabic: الإِمَامِ التَّقِيِّ النَّقِيِّ وَحُجَّتِكَ عَلَىٰ مَنْ فَوْقَ الأَرْضِ
lines.transliteration: al-imami alttaqiyyi alnnaqiyyi wa hujjatika `ala man fawqa al-ardi
lines.english: the pious and clean leader, and Your argument against all those on the earth

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ تَحْتَ الثَّرَىٰ الصِّدِّيقِ الشَّهِيدِ صَلاةً كَثِيرَةً نَامِيَةً
lines.transliteration: wa man tahta alththara alssiddiqi alshshahidi salatan kathiratan namiyatan
lines.english: and all those under the ground; the truthful and martyr; many, increasing,

lines.arabic: زَاكِيَةً مُتَوَاصِلَةً مُتَرَادِفَةً كَأَفْضَلِ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِنْ أَوْلِيَائِكَ
lines.transliteration: zakiyatan mutawasilatan mutaradifatan ka-afdala ma sallayta `ala ahadin min awliya'ika
lines.english: pure, continuous, and consecutive blessings; as the best blessings that You have ever poured on any of Your allies.

title: Salawaat of Imam Muhammad al-Jawad (as)
description: Salawaat upon the generous, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Jawad (peace be upon him).

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسَىٰ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadi bni `aliyyi bni musa
lines.english: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad the son of `Ali the son of Musa.

title: Salawaat Shabania
description: Recited everyday at mid-day (Zawal) and also at mid-night in the month of Shabaan. Attributed to Imam Sajjad (as).

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ شَجَرَةِ النُّبُوَّةِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin shajarat alnnubuwwati
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, the tree of prophethood,

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً كَثِيرَةً تَكُونُ لَهُمْ رِضاً
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin salatan kathiratan takunu lahum ridan
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad with many blessings that would please them

lines.arabic: وَلِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ أَدَاءً وَقَضَاءً بِحَوْلٍ مِنْكَ وَقُوَّةٍ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa lihaqqi muhammadin wa ali muhammadin ada'an wa qada'an bihawlin minka wa quwwatin ya rabba al-`alamina
lines.english: and fulfill the right of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, by Your power and might, O Lord of the Worlds.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ الطَّيِّبِينَ الأَبْرَارِ الأَخْيَارِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin alttayyibina al-abrari al-akhyari
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, the pure, the righteous, the chosen ones,

lines.arabic: الَّذِينَ أَوْجَبْتَ حُقُوقَهُمْ وَفَرَضْتَ طَاعَتَهُمْ وَوِلايَتَهُمْ
lines.transliteration: alladhina awjabta huquqahum wa faradta ta`atahum wa wilayatahum
lines.english: whose rights You have made obligatory, and whose obedience and guardianship You have made compulsory.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاعْمُرْ قَلْبِي بِطَاعَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin wa`mur qalbi bita`atika
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and make my heart thrive with Your obedience,

lines.arabic: وَلا تُخْزِنِي بِمَعْصِيَتِكَ وَارْزُقْنِي مُوَاسَاةَ مَنْ قَتَّرْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa la tukhzini bima`siyatika warzuqni muwasata man qattarta `alayhi min rizqika
lines.english: and do not disgrace me with Your disobedience, and grant me the grace to help those whose sustenance You have restricted,

lines.arabic: بِمَا وَسَّعْتَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ وَنَشَرْتَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ عَدْلِكَ وَأَحْيَيْتَنِي تَحْتَ ظِلِّكَ
lines.transliteration: bima wassa`ta `alayya min fadlika wa nasharta `alayya min `adlika wa ahyaytani tahta zillika
lines.english: by the abundance You have bestowed upon me from Your grace, and the justice You have spread for me, and by keeping me alive under Your shade.

lines.arabic: وَهَذَا شَهْرُ نَبِيِّكَ سَيِّدِ رُسُلِكَ شَعْبَانُ الَّذِي حَفَفْتَهُ مِنْكَ بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَالرِّضْوَانِ
lines.transliteration: wa hadha shahru nabiyyika sayyidi rusulika sha`banu alladhi hafaftahu minka birrahmati walrridwani
lines.english: And this is the month of Your Prophet, the master of Your messengers - Sha'ban, which You have encompassed with Your mercy and pleasure,

lines.arabic: الَّذِي كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَدْأَبُ فِي صِيَامِهِ وَقِيَامِهِ
lines.transliteration: alladhi kana rasulu allahi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa sallama yad'abu fi siyamihi wa qiyamihi
lines.english: in which the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to exert himself in fasting and standing (in prayer)

lines.arabic: فِي لَيَالِيهِ وَأَيَّامِهِ بُخُوعاً لَكَ فِي إِكْرَامِهِ وَإِعْظَامِهِ إِلَىٰ مَحَلِّ حِمَامِهِ
lines.transliteration: fi layalihi wa ayyamihi bukhu`an laka fi ikramihi wa i`zamihi ila mahalli himamihi
lines.english: in its nights and days, in submission to You, in honoring and magnifying it until the time of his death.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَأَعِنَّا عَلَىٰ الاسْتِنَانِ بِسُنَّتِهِ فِيهِ وَنَيْلِ الشَّفَاعَةِ لَدَيْهِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma fa'a`inna `ala alistinani bisunnatihi fihi wa nayli alshshafa`ati ladayhi
lines.english: O Allah, help us to follow his example in it and to attain his intercession.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَاجْعَلْهُ لِي شَفِيعاً مُشَفَّعاً وَطَرِيقاً إِلَيْكَ مَهْيَعاً
lines.transliteration: allahumma waj`alhu li shafi`an mushaffa`an wa tarigan ilayka mahya`an
lines.english: O Allah, make him an intercessor for me whose intercession is accepted, and a clear path to You,

lines.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِي لَهُ مُتَّبِعاً حَتَّىٰ أَلْقَاكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَنِّي رَاضِياً
lines.transliteration: waj`alni lahu muttabi`an hatta alqaka yawma alqiyamati `anni radiyan
lines.english: and make me follow him until I meet You on the Day of Resurrection while You are pleased with me

lines.arabic: وَعَنْ ذُنُوبِي غَاضِياً قَدْ أَوْجَبْتَ لِي مِنْكَ الرَّحْمَةَ وَالرِّضْوَانَ
lines.transliteration: wa `an dhunubi ghadiyan qad awjabta li minka alrrahmata walrridwana
lines.english: and overlooking my sins, having made Your mercy and pleasure obligatory for me,

lines.transliteration: wa anzaltani dara alqarari wa mahalla al-akhyari
lines.english: and having settled me in the eternal abode and the place of the righteous.

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ إِمَامِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala `aliyyi bni al-husayni imami almu'minina
lines.english: And bless `Ali the son of al-Husayn, the leader of the believers,

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ إِمَامِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin bni `aliyyin imami almu'minina
lines.english: And bless Muhammad the son of `Ali, the leader of the believers,

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ إِمَامِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala ja`fari bni muhammadin imami almu'minina
lines.english: And bless Ja`far the son of Muhammad, the leader of the believers,

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ إِمَامِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala musa bni ja`farin imami almu'minina
lines.english: And bless Musa the son of Ja`far, the leader of the believers,

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُوسَىٰ إِمَامِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala `aliyyi bni musa imami almu'minina
lines.english: And bless `Ali the son of Musa, the leader of the believers,

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ إِمَامِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin bni `aliyyin imami almu'minina
lines.english: And bless Muhammad the son of `Ali, the leader of the believers,

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ إِمَامِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala `aliyyi bni muhammadin imami almu'minina
lines.english: And bless `Ali the son of Muhammad, the leader of the believers,

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ إِمَامِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala al-hasani bni `aliyyin imami almu'minina
lines.english: And bless al-Hasan the son of `Ali, the leader of the believers,

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ الْخَلَفِ الْهَادِي الْمَهْدِيِّ إِمَامِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala al-khalafi al-hadi al-mahdiyyi imami almu'minina
lines.english: And bless the successor, the guide, the well-guided, the leader of the believers,

lines.transliteration: wa warithi al-mursalina wa hujjati rabbi al-`alamina
lines.english: the inheritor of the Messengers, and the argument of the Lord of the worlds.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الأَئِمَّةِ الْهَادِينَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ahli baytihi al-a'immati al-hadina
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his Household, the leaders, the guides,

lines.arabic: الْعُلَمَاءِ الصَّادِقِينَ الأَبْرَارِ الْمُتَّقِينَ دَعَائِمِ دِينِكَ
lines.transliteration: al-`ulamai' al-sadiqina al-abrari al-muttaqina da`a'imi dinika
lines.english: the scholars, the truthful, the righteous, the pious, the pillars of Your religion,

lines.arabic: وَأَرْكَانِ تَوْحِيدِكَ وَتَرَاجِمَةِ وَحْيِكَ وَحُجَجِكَ عَلَىٰ خَلْقِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa arkani tawhidika wa tarajimati wahyika wa hujajika `ala khalqika
lines.english: the cornerstones of Your Oneness, the interpreters of Your revelation, and Your arguments over Your creatures,

lines.arabic: وَخُلَفَائِكَ فِي أَرْضِكَ الَّذِينَ اخْتَرْتَهُمْ لِنَفْسِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa khulafa'ika fi ardika alladhina ikhtartahum linafsika
lines.english: and Your vicegerents on Your earth whom You have chosen for Yourself,
selected over Your servants, and pleased for Your religion,

lines.transliteration: wa khassastahum bima`rifatika wa jallaltahum bikaramatika
lines.english: endowed with Your knowledge, and covered with Your honor,

lines.transliteration: wa ghashshaytahum birahmatika wa rabbaytahum bini`matika
lines.english: shrouded with Your mercy, and brought up with Your grace,

lines.transliteration: wa ghadhdhaytahum bihikmatika wa albastahum nuraka
lines.english: nourished with Your wisdom, and dressed with Your light,

lines.transliteration: wa rafa`tahum fi malakutika wa hafaftahum bimala'ikatika
lines.english: raised to Your kingdom, and surrounded with Your angels,

lines.transliteration: wa akramtahum binabiyyika salawatuka `alayhi wa alihi
lines.english: and honored with Your Prophet – Your blessings be upon him and his Household.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَيْهِمْ صَلاةً زَاكِيَةً نَامِيَةً
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa `alayhim salatan zakiyatan namiyatan
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and them with pure, ever-growing blessings,

lines.arabic: كَثِيرَةً دَائِمَةً طَيِّبَةً لا يُحِيطُ بِهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
lines.transliteration: kathiratan da'imatan tayyibatan la yuhitu biha illa anta
lines.english: many, permanent, and good that none can encompass save You,

lines.arabic: وَلا يَسَعُهَا إِلاَّ عِلْمُكَ وَلا يُحْصِيهَا أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكَ
lines.transliteration: wa la yasa`uha illa `ilmuka wa la yuhsiha ahadun ghayruka
lines.english: nothing can contain save Your knowledge, and none can count save You.

title: Ziyarat Ahlulbayt
description: It is recommended to visit the Ahlulbayt (as) on Fridays.

lines.english: Peace be upon you, O Prophet
and be upon you Allah’s mercy and blessings.
Peace be upon you, O missioned Prophet,
(and peace be upon you) O well-pleased successor (of the Prophet),
(and peace be upon you) O grand lady,
(and peace be upon you) O Luminous lady,
(and peace be upon you) O two elite grandsons (of the Prophet),
(and peace be upon you) O descendants—the elite signs
and the well-selected trustees.
Here I am devoting myself to you,

lines.transliteration: wa ila aba'ikum wa waladikum alkhalafi
lines.english: to your fathers, and to your son, the Successor
on the blessing of the truth.
My heart is thus subservient to you
and my support is prepared for you
until Allah will judge about His religion.
I am with you, verily with you
but not with your enemy.
I am one of them who believe in your superiority
and I acknowledge your Return.
I never deny the all-powerfulness of Allah

lines.arabic: وَلاَ أَزْعُمُ إِلاَّ مَا شَاءَ ٱللَّهُ
lines.transliteration: wa la az`umu illa ma sha'a allahu
lines.english: and I do not claim but that which Allah wills.
Glory be to Allah, Lord of kingdom and realm.
All His creatures glorify Allah by His Names.
Peace be upon your souls and your bodies.

lines.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alaykum wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
lines.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you all.

title: Ziyarat 12th Imam (Friday)
description: Special Ziyarat for Imam al-Mahdi (ajtfs) on Fridays.

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِي أَرْضِهِ
lines.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya hujjata allahi fi ardihi
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O argument of Allah in His lands!

lines.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَيْنَ ٱللَّهِ فِي خَلْقِهِ
lines.english: Peace be upon you, O sight of Allah on His creatures!
Peace be upon you, O light of Allah
by which those who have been guided [to the true guidance] are guided
and by which the believers are relieved!
Peace be upon you, O polite and fearful!
Peace be upon you, O sincere patron!
Peace be upon you, O ark of salvation!
Peace be upon you, O essence of life!
Peace be upon you.
May Allah send blessings to you
and upon your Household,
the pure and immaculate.
Peace be upon you.
May Allah hasten that which He has promised you;
namely, victory and prevalence of your authority.
Peace be upon you, O my master.
I am a servant of you
and I recognize the first and the last of your affair.

lines.arabic: أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ بِكَ وَبِآلِ بَيْتِكَ
lines.transliteration: ataqarrabu ila allahi ta`ala bika wa bi-ali baytika
lines.english: I seek nearness to Allah, the Exalted, through your Household and you

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَظِرُ ظُهُورَكَ وَظُهُورَ ٱلْحَقِّ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْكَ
lines.transliteration: wa antaziru zuhuraka wa zuhura alhaqqi `ala yadayka
lines.english: and I am expecting your advent and the prevalence of the truth at your hands.

lines.arabic: وَأَسْأَلُ ٱللَّهَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: wa as'alu allaha an yusalliya `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: And I beseech Allah to send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

lines.transliteration: wa an yaj`alani mina almuntazirina laka
lines.english: and to include me with those who are expecting you,
those who follow you and support you against your enemies,

lines.arabic: وَٱلْمُسْتَشْهَدِينَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ فِي جُمْلَةِ أَوْلِيَائِكَ
lines.transliteration: walmustash-hadina bayna yadayka fi jumlati awliya'ika
lines.english: and those who will be martyred in front of you in the group of your loyalists.
O my master, O Patron of the Age!
May Allah’s blessings be upon you
and upon your Household.
Today is Friday,

lines.transliteration: wa huwa yawmuka almutawaqqa`u fihi zuhuruka
lines.english: which is your day on which your advent is expected
to bring about relief to the believers at your hands,
and killing of the disbelievers with your sword.

lines.arabic: وَأَنَا يَا مَوْلاَيَ فِيهِ ضَيْفُكَ وَجَارُكَ
lines.transliteration: wa ana ya mawlaya fihi dayfuka wa jaruka
lines.english: On this day, O my master, I am your guest and in your vicinity

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ كَرِيمٌ مِنْ أَوْلاَدِ ٱلْكِرَامِ
lines.transliteration: wa anta ya mawlaya karimun min awladi alkirami
lines.english: and you, my master, are generous and the descendant of the generous people,
and you are commanded to receive your guests and neighbors hospitably;
so, receive me as your guest and neighbor.
May Allah’s blessings be upon you
and upon your Household, the immaculate.

title: Salwat of Abu’l-Hasan al-Zarrab al-Isfahani
description: Narration attributed to Abu’l-Hasan al-Zarrab al-Isfahani.

lines.english: In the Name of Allah, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
lines.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings to Muhammad, the master of the messengers (of Allah),
the seal of the Prophets,
and the Argument of the Lord of the worlds [against His creatures]
who had been elected [for Prophethood] since the Covenant
and chosen since the World of Shadows,
and who is purified from all defects
and freed from all deficiencies,
and who is hoped for salvation
and expected for intercession,
and to whom the religion of Allah is delegated.
O Allah, (please) confer honor upon his structure,
ennoble his authority,
make successful his cogency,
lift up his rank,
light up his illumination,
make his face glow with whiteness,
grant him merit, virtue,
[supreme] position, [right of] mediation,
and sublime rank,
and send him a praiseworthy status
which the past and last generations will wish to have.
And send blessings to `Ali, the Commander of the Believers,
the inheritor of the Messengers,
the leader of the white-forehead groups,
the chief of the Prophets’ Successors,
and the argument of the Lord of the worlds.
And send blessings to al-Hasan, the son of `Ali,
the leader of the faithful believers,
the inheritor of the Messengers,
and the argument of the Lord of the worlds.
And send blessings to al-Husayn, the son of `Ali,
the leader of the faithful believers,
the inheritor of the Messengers,
and the argument of the Lord of the worlds.
And send blessings to `Ali, the son of al-Husayn,
the leader of the faithful believers,
the inheritor of the Messengers,
and the argument of the Lord of the worlds.
And send blessings to Muhammad, the son of `Ali,
the leader of the faithful believers,
the inheritor of the Messengers,
and the argument of the Lord of the worlds.
And send blessings to Ja`far, the son of Muhammad,
the leader of the faithful believers,
the inheritor of the Messengers,
and the argument of the Lord of the worlds.
And send blessings to Musa, the son of Ja`far,
the leader of the faithful believers,
the inheritor of the Messengers,
and the argument of the Lord of the worlds.
And send blessings to `Ali, the son of Musa,
the leader of the faithful believers,
the inheritor of the Messengers,
and the argument of the Lord of the worlds.
And send blessings to Muhammad, the son of `Ali,
the leader of the faithful believers,
the inheritor of the Messengers,
and the argument of the Lord of the worlds.
And send blessings to `Ali, son of Muhammad,
the leader of the faithful believers,
the inheritor of the Messengers,
and the argument of the Lord of the worlds.
And send blessings to al-Hasan, son of `Ali,
the leader of the faithful believers,
the inheritor of the Messengers,
and the argument of the Lord of the worlds.
And send blessings to the Successor, the guide and well-guided,
the leader of the faithful believers,
the inheritor of the Messengers,
and the argument of the Lord of the worlds.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ahli baytihi
lines.english: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and his Household,
the guiding Imams,
the knowledgeable, the veracious,
the righteous, the pious,
the supports of Your religion,
the pillars of the belief in Your Oneness,
the interpreters of Your Revelation,
Your arguments on Your creatures,
and Your representatives in Your lands,
whom You have chosen for Yourself,
You have preferred over Your servants,
You have accepted (as directors) of Your religion,
You have given Your knowledge exclusively,
shaded with Your honoring,
covered with Your mercy,
raised with Your boon,
fed on Your wisdom,
dressed Your Light,
lifted up to Your Sovereignty,
encompassed with Your angels,
and honored with Your Prophet,
peace of You be upon him and his Household.
O Allah, (please) send blessings to Muhammad and upon them
with blessings that are so pure, ever-growing,
opulent, permanent, and good
that none can comprehend save You,
none can embrace save Your knowledge,
and none can count save You.
O Allah, and also send blessings to Your Friend
who will restore Your way,
rise [to undertake the mission] by Your command,
call unto You,
and guide to You.
[He is] Your argument against Your creatures,
Your representative in Your lands,
and Your witness on Your servants.
O Allah, (please) confer upon him with a mighty help,
extend his lifetime,
and adorn the earth with his long-lasting survival.
O Allah, (please) save him from the oppression of the enviers,
protect him against the evils of the plotters,
deter the unjust from employing their wills against him,
and redeem him from the hands (i.e. powers) of the tyrants.

lines.transliteration: allahumma a`tihi fi nafsihi wa dhurriyyatihi
lines.english: O Allah, (please) grant him, concerning himself, his offspring,
his partisans, his subjects,
his retinue, his publics,
[even] his enemies, and all the inhabitants of this world—
[give him] that which delights his eye
and entertains his self;
and make him attain the best of that which he desires
in this world and the Next Word.
Verily, You have power over all things.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ جَدِّدْ بِهِ مَا ٱمَتَحَىٰ مِنْ دِينِكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma jaddid bihi ma imtaha min dinika
lines.english: O Allah, renew, through him, the features of Your religion that have been eradicated,

lines.arabic: أَحْيِ بِهِ مَا بُدِّلَ مِنْ كِتَابِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa ahyi bihi ma buddila min kitabika
lines.english: revive, through him, the instructions of Your Books that have been altered,

lines.arabic: وَأَظْهِرْ بِهِ مَا غُيِّرَ مِنْ حُكْمِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa azhir bihi ma ghuyyira min hukmika
lines.english: and manifest, through him, the laws of Your code that have been distorted

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ يَعُودَ دِينُكَ بِهِ وَعَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ
lines.transliteration: hatta ya`uda dinuka bihi wa `ala yadayhi
lines.english: so that Your religion, through him and at his hands, will again become
fresh, new,
pure, sound,

lines.arabic: لاَ شَكَّ فِيهِ وَلاَ شُبْهَةَ مَعَهُ
lines.transliteration: la shakka fihi wa la shubhata ma`ahu
lines.english: free from any doubt or any spurious matter,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ بَاطِلَ عِنْدَهُ وَلاَ بِدْعَةَ لَدَيْهِ
lines.transliteration: wa la batila `indahu wa la bid`ata ladayhi
lines.english: and lacking any accompanying wrong or heresy.
O Allah, through his light, light up all darkness,
through his power, demolish all heresies,
through his might, destroy all items of deviation,
through him, annihilate all tyrants,
though his sword, extinguish all fires [of sedition],

lines.transliteration: wa ahlik bi`adlihi jawra kulli ja'irin
lines.english: through his justice, terminate the prejudice of all unjust ones,
make his rule prevail on all systems of rule,
and through his authority, humiliate all other authorities.
O Allah, (please) put down all those who antagonize him,
wipe out all those who incur the hostility of him,
exterminate the plots of all those who conspire against him,
and obliterate all those who deny his right,
belittle his mission,
work on extinguishing his light,
and intend to turn off his reputation.
O Allah, (please) send blessings to Muhammad, the Chosen Prophet,
`Ali, the Well-pleased,
Fatimah, the Luminous,
al-Hasan, the amicable,
al-Husayn, the purified,
and all the Successors, the lanterns of darkness,
the signs of true guidance,
the lamps of piety,
the firmest handle,
the resolved rope [between Allah and His creatures],
and the straight path.
And (please) send blessings to Your Friend and the trustees of Your affairs
and the Imams from his descendants,
extend their lifetimes,
increase their periods of life,
and make them attain the utmost of their expectations
in the religion, the world, and the Hereafter.
Verily, You have power over all things.

title: Salawat of Ahlulbayt
description: Invocation of Blessings Upon the Holy Infallibles on Fridays.

lines.transliteration: inna allaha wa mala'ikatahu yusalluna `ala alnnabiyyi
lines.english: “Lo! Allah and His angels shower blessings on the Prophet.

lines.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا ٱلَّذينَ آمَنُوٱ صَلُّوٱ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوٱ تَسْليماً.»
lines.transliteration: ya ayyuha alladhina amanu sallu `alayhi wa sallimu tasliman
lines.english: O you who believe, ask blessings on him and salute him with a worthy salutation.”

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, send peace upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

lines.transliteration: wa barik `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

lines.transliteration: wa tahannan `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: have compassion upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

lines.transliteration: wa sallim `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: and send benedictions upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
as much as You have sent peace, blessings,
mercy, compassion,

lines.transliteration: wa sallamta `ala ibrahima wa ali ibrahima
lines.english: and benedictions upon (Prophet) Abraham and the Household of Abraham.
You are verily Owner of praise, Owner of glory.
O Allah, give Muhammad [the right of] mediation,
honor, virtue,
and noble rank.

lines.transliteration: allahumma ij`al muhammadan wa ala muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, make Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

lines.arabic: أَعْظَمَ ٱلْخَلاَئِقِ كُلِّهِمْ شَرَفاً يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ
lines.transliteration: a`zama alkhala'iqi kullihim sharafan yawma alqiyamati
lines.english: to be the most honored of all Your creatures on the Resurrection Day,
the closest to You in position,
the most notable with You on the Resurrection Day,
and the most favorable in title and status.
O Allah, give Muhammad the most honorable position,
the most abundant salutation,
and the intercession of Islam.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَلْحِقْنَا بِهِ غَيْرَ خَزَايَا وَلاَ نَاكِثِينَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma wa alhiqna bihi ghayra khazaya wa la nakithina
lines.english: O Allah, join us to him while we are neither disgraced, nor violating,

lines.transliteration: wa la nadimina wa la mubaddilina
lines.english: nor regretful, nor distorting.
O God of all worlds, respond to us.

title: Salawat on Prophet (saws)
description: Salawat on the Holy Prophet (saws) after Asr on Friday.

lines.english: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَ إِنَّ مُحَمَّدَاً كَمَا وَصَفْتَهُ في كِتَابكَ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma inna Muḥammadan kamā waṣaftahu fī kitābik
lines.english: O Allah, indeed Muhammad is as You described him in Your Book

lines.arabic: حَيْثُ تَقُولُ ﴿لَقَدْ جاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾
lines.transliteration: Ḥaythu taqūlu (Laqad jā’akum rasūlun min anfusikum)
lines.english: Where You say, "There has come to you a Messenger from among yourselves"

lines.arabic: عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُمْ
lines.english: It grieves him that you should perish; he is deeply concerned for you
To the believers, he is compassionate and merciful
So I bear witness that he is as You described him
And that You did not command prayers upon him,

lines.arabic: إلاَّ بَعْدَ أَنْ صَلَّيْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْتَ وَمَلاَئِكَتُكَ
lines.transliteration: Illā ba‘da an ṣallayta ‘alayhi anta wa malā’ikatuk
lines.english: Except after You and Your angels prayed upon him

lines.arabic: وَأَنْزَلْتَ فِي مُحْكَمِ قُرْآنِكَ ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلائِكَتَهُ﴾
lines.transliteration: Wa anzalta fī muḥkam Qur’ānika (Inna Allāha wa malā’ikatuhu)
lines.english: And You revealed in Your clear Qur’an, "Indeed, Allah and His angels"
Send blessings upon the Prophet

lines.arabic: يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيماً
lines.transliteration: Yā ayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ṣallū ‘alayhi wa sallimū taslīmā
lines.english: O you who have believed, ask [Allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allah to grant him] peace
Not out of need for the prayer of any of the creatures,
From the created beings after Your prayer upon him,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ إِلَى تَزْكِيَتِهِمْ إِيَّاهُ بَعْدَ تَزْكِيَتِكَ
lines.transliteration: Wa lā ilā tazkiyatihim iyyāh ba‘da tazkiyatika
lines.english: Nor to their purifying him after Your purification of him,

lines.arabic: بَلِ الْخَلْقُ جَميِعاً هُمْ الْمُحْتَاجُونَ إلى ذلِكَ
lines.transliteration: Bal al-khalqu jamī‘an hum al-muḥtājūn ilā dhālik
lines.english: Rather, all creatures are in need of that
Because You made him Your door,

lines.arabic: لاَ تَقْبَلُ مِمَّنْ أَتَاكَ إِلاَّ مِنْهُ
lines.transliteration: Lā taqbal min man atāk illā minhu
lines.english: From which You do not accept anyone except through him
And You made the prayer upon him a means of drawing near to You,
And a means to You and a closeness in Your presence

lines.arabic: وَدَلَلْتَ المُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْه وَأَمْرتهم بِالصَلاةِ عَلَيْهِ
lines.transliteration: Wa dalalta al-mu’minīn ‘alayh wa amartahum bi-ṣṣalāti ‘alayh
lines.english: And You guided the believers to him and commanded them to pray upon him,
So they may increase in preference with You and honor in Your sight
And You entrusted Your angels with those who pray upon him,
They pray upon him and convey their prayers to him,
And their greetings of peace

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ رَبَّ مُحَّمَدٍ صَلّى اللهُ عَليهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma rabba Muḥammad ṣallā Allāhu ‘alayh wa ālih
lines.english: O Allah, the Lord of Muhammad, may Allah’s blessings be upon him and his family

lines.arabic: فَإِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا عَظَّمْتَ مِنْ أَمْرِ مُحَّمَدٍ
lines.transliteration: Fa-innī as’aluka bimā ‘aẓẓamta min amri Muḥammad
lines.english: Indeed, I ask You by what You have magnified of the matter of Muhammad,
And what You have made obligatory of his right,

lines.arabic: أَنْ تُطْلِقَ لِسَانِي مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ عَلَيْهِ
lines.english: That You set my tongue free to pray upon him,
In what You love and are pleased with,

lines.arabic: وَبِمَا لَمْ تُطْلِقْ بِهِ لِسَانَ أَحَدٍ
lines.transliteration: Wa bimā lam tuṭliq bihi lisān aḥad
lines.english: And in what You have not set free the tongue of anyone,

lines.transliteration: Min khalqika wa lam tu‘ṭihi iyyāh
lines.english: From Your creation, and have not granted him
Then grant me, through that, his companionship,
Where You have placed him in Your sanctity,
And the gardens of Your paradise

lines.transliteration: Thumma lā tufarriq baynī wa baynah
lines.english: Then do not separate me from him
O Allah, I begin with bearing witness to him,
Then with the prayer upon him,

lines.arabic: وَإِنْ كُنْتُ لاَ أَبْلُغُ مِنْ ذلِكَ رِضى نَفْسِي
lines.transliteration: Wa in kuntu lā ablughu min dhālik riḍā nafsī
lines.english: And if I do not reach, through that, the satisfaction of myself,
Nor my tongue expresses what is in my heart,
Nor am I blamed for my shortcoming,

lines.arabic: لِعَجْزِ قُدْرَتِي عَنْ بُلُوغِ الْوَاجِبِ عَلَيَّ
lines.english: Due to my inability to fulfill what is obligatory upon me,
From him, because it is my portion,

lines.transliteration: Wa ḥaqqun ‘alayy wa adā’un limā awjabta
lines.english: And a right upon me and fulfillment of what You have made obligatory,

lines.arabic: لَهُ فِي عُنُقِي أَنْ بَلَّغَ رِسَالاَتِكَ
lines.english: To him, as he conveyed Your messages,
Without neglecting what You commanded,
Nor exceeding what You prohibited,
Nor falling short in what You desired,
Nor transgressing what You advised
And he recited Your verses as You revealed them,

lines.transliteration: Ilayh waḥyik wa jāhada fī sabīlik
lines.english: To him, Your revelation, and he strived in Your cause,
Advancing, not retreating,

lines.transliteration: Wa fā bi-‘ahdika wa ṣaddaqa wa‘daka
lines.english: Fulfilling Your covenant and confirming Your promise,

lines.arabic: وَصَدَعَ بِأَمْرِكَ لاَ يَخَافُ فِيكَ لَوْمَةَ لاَئِمٍ
lines.transliteration: Wa ṣada‘a bi-amrika lā yakhāfu fīka lawmata lā’im
lines.english: And he proclaimed Your command, not fearing the blame of any critic

lines.arabic: وَبَاعَدَ فِيكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ وَقَرَّبَ فِيكَ الأَبْعَدِينَ
lines.transliteration: Wa bā‘ada fīka al-aqrabīn wa qarraba fīka al-ab‘adīn
lines.english: And he distanced for Your sake the nearest and brought near for Your sake the farthest
And he commanded with Your obedience and was commanded by it,
In secret and in public
And he forbade Your disobedience and refrained from it

lines.arabic: وَدَلَّ عَلَى مَحَاسِنِ الأَخْلاَقِ وَأَخَذَ بِهَا
lines.transliteration: Wa dalla ‘ala maḥāsin al-akhlāq wa akhadha bihā
lines.english: And he guided to good manners and adhered to them,

lines.arabic: وَنَهَى عَنْ مَسَاوِي الأَخْلاَقِ وَرَغِبَ عَنْهَا
lines.transliteration: Wa nahā ‘an masāwī al-akhlāq wa raghaba ‘anhā
lines.english: And he forbade bad manners and abstained from them
And he befriended Your allies with what You love,
To be befriended in word and deed

lines.arabic: وَدَعَا إلى سَبيِلكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ
lines.transliteration: Wa da‘ā ilā sabīlik bi-al-ḥikmati wa al-maw‘iẓati al-ḥasana
lines.english: And he called to Your way with wisdom and good counsel,
And he worshiped You sincerely until certainty came to him,
And You took him to Yourself, pious, pure, and righteous,

lines.arabic: قَدْ أًكْمَلْتَ بِهِ الدِّينَ وَأَتْمَمْتَ بِهِ النَّعِيمَ
lines.transliteration: Qad akmalt bihi al-dīn wa atmamta bihi al-na‘īm
lines.english: Having completed the religion through him and perfected the blessings through him,
And manifested the proofs through him,
And established the laws of Islam through him,
And distinguished the lawful from the unlawful through him,

lines.transliteration: Wa nahajta bihi li-khalqik ṣirāṭaka al-mustaqīm
lines.english: And guided Your creation through him to Your straight path,

lines.transliteration: Wa bayyanta bihi al-‘alāmāt wa al-nujūm
lines.english: And clarified through him the signs and stars,
By which they are guided
And You did not leave them in blindness after him,

lines.transliteration: Yahīmūna wa lā fī shubhah yatīhūn
lines.english: Wandering in confusion, nor in doubt

lines.transliteration: Wa lam takilhum ilā al-naẓar li-anfusihim
lines.english: And You did not leave them to their own views in their religion,
According to their opinions,
Nor their choosing according to their desires,
Lest they be divided into the darkness of innovations,
And be confounded in the overwhelming darkness,

lines.transliteration: Wa tatafarraqu bihim al-subul fīmā ya‘lamūn
lines.english: And the paths diverge for them in what they know

lines.transliteration: Wa ashhadu annahu tawallā min al-dunyā
lines.english: And I bear witness that he departed from this world,
Pleased with You, and You pleased with him, praiseworthy
Among the near ones, and Your prophets, the messengers,
And Your righteous chosen servants,

lines.transliteration: Wa annahu ghayru mulīm wa lā dhamīm
lines.english: And he is not blameworthy nor disgraceful,

lines.transliteration: Wa annahu lam yakun min al-mutakallifīn
lines.english: And he was not among those who pretend,

lines.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ سَاحِراً وَلاَ سُحِرَ لَهُ
lines.transliteration: Wa annahu lam yakun sāḥirā wa lā suḥira lah
lines.english: And he was not a magician, nor was he bewitched,

lines.transliteration: Wa lā kāhinan wa lā tuku’hina lah
lines.english: Nor a soothsayer, nor was soothsaying done for him,

lines.transliteration: Wa lā shā‘iran wa lā shu’‘ira lah
lines.english: Nor a poet, nor was poetry composed for him,

lines.transliteration: Wa lā kadhdhābā wa annahu kāna rasūlak
lines.english: Nor a liar, and indeed he was Your messenger,
And the seal of the prophets,
Who brought the truth from You,
And confirmed the messengers
And I bear witness that those who denied him,
Will taste the painful punishment

lines.arabic: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مَا أَتَانَا بِهِ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
lines.transliteration: Wa ashhadu anna mā atānā bihi min ‘indika
lines.english: And I bear witness that what he brought to us from You,

lines.arabic: وَأَخْبَرَنَا بِهِ عَنْكَ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ الْيَقِينُ
lines.transliteration: Wa akhbaranā bihi ‘anka annahu al-ḥaqq al-yaqīn
lines.english: And informed us about You is the absolute truth,

lines.arabic: لاَ شَكَّ فِيهِ مِنْ رَبِّ العَالَمِين
lines.transliteration: Lā shakk fīhi min rabbi al-‘ālamīn
lines.english: There is no doubt in it from the Lord of the worlds
O Allah, so bless Muhammad,

lines.transliteration: ‘Abdika wa rasūlika wa nabiyyika wa waliyyika
lines.english: Your servant, Your messenger, Your prophet, and Your chosen one,

lines.transliteration: Wa najīyyika wa ṣafiyyika wa ṣafwatika wa khīratika
lines.english: Your confidant, Your chosen one, Your pure one, and Your elite,
From Your creation, the one You chose for Your messages,
And selected him for Your religion,
And entrusted him with Your servants and Your revelation
The flag of guidance and the gate of wisdom,

lines.arabic: وَالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقى فِيمَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ خَلْقِكَ
lines.transliteration: Wa al-‘urwati al-wuthqā fīmā baynak wa bayna khalqik
lines.english: And the firm handle between You and Your creation,
The witness over them, the guardian over them,

lines.transliteration: Ashraf wa afḍal wa azkā wa aṭhar
lines.english: The most noble, the best, the purest, and the cleanest,

lines.arabic: وَأَنْمَى وَأَطْيَبَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ
lines.transliteration: Wa anmā wa aṭyab mā ṣallayta ‘alā aḥad
lines.english: And the most elevated and the best of what You have prayed upon anyone,

lines.transliteration: Min khalqik wa anbiyā’ika wa rusulik
lines.english: From Your creation, Your prophets, and Your messengers,
And Your chosen ones, and the sincere among Your servants

lines.transliteration: Allāhumma wa aj‘al ṣalawātik wa ghufrānak
lines.english: O Allah, and make Your blessings and forgiveness,

lines.transliteration: Wa riḍwānak wa mu‘āfātak wa karāmatak wa raḥmatak
lines.english: And Your pleasure, well-being, honor, and mercy,

lines.transliteration: Wa mannak wa faḍlak wa salāmak wa sharafak
lines.english: And Your grace, bounty, peace, and glory,

lines.transliteration: Wa i‘ẓāmak wa tabjīlak wa ṣalawāt malā’ikatak
lines.english: And Your exaltation, reverence, and the prayers of Your angels,

lines.transliteration: Wa rusulik wa anbiyā’ik wa al-awṣiyā’ wa al-shuhadā’
lines.english: And Your messengers, prophets, successors, and martyrs,
And the truthful among Your righteous servants,
And what excellent companions they are,

lines.transliteration: Wa ahl al-samāwāt wa al-arḍīn wa mā baynahumā
lines.english: And the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth and what is between them,

lines.transliteration: Wa mā fawqahumā wa mā taḥtahumā
lines.english: And what is above them and what is below them,

lines.arabic: وِ مِا بَيْنَ الخَافِقِيْنِ وَمَا بَيْنَ الهَوَاءِ
lines.transliteration: Wa mā bayna al-khāfiqīn wa mā bayna al-hawā’
lines.english: And what is between the horizons and what is in the air,

lines.transliteration: Wa al-shams wa al-qamar wa al-nujūm wa al-jibāl
lines.english: And the sun, the moon, the stars, and the mountains,

lines.transliteration: Wa al-shajar wa al-dawābb wa mā sabaḥ laka
lines.english: And the trees, the animals, and what glorifies You,

lines.transliteration: Fī al-birr wa al-baḥr wa fī al-ẓulma
lines.english: In the land, the sea, and in the darkness,
And in the light, in the mornings and the evenings,

lines.arabic: وَفِي آنَاءِ اللَّيْلِ وَأَطْرَافِ النَّهَارِ وَسَاعَاِتِه
lines.transliteration: Wa fī ānā’ al-layl wa aṭrāf al-nahār wa sā‘ātih
lines.english: And in the hours of the night and the parts of the day and its hours,
Upon Muhammad, son of ‘Abdullāh,
The master of the messengers and the seal of the prophets,

lines.transliteration: Wa imām al-muttaqīn wa mawlā al-mu’minīn
lines.english: The leader of the pious and the protector of the believers,

lines.transliteration: Wa waliyy al-muslimīn wa qā’id al-ghurr al-muḥajjilīn
lines.english: The guardian of the Muslims and the leader of the radiant ones,
The messenger of the Lord of the worlds,

lines.transliteration: Min al-jinn wa al-ins wa al-a‘jamīn
lines.english: From among the jinn, humans, and the non-Arabs,

lines.transliteration: Wa al-shāhid al-bashīr wa al-amīn al-nadhīr
lines.english: The witness, the bringer of good news, the trustworthy warner,
The caller to You by Your permission,
The illuminating lamp,

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
Among the first ones, and bless Muhammad,
And the family of Muhammad among the last ones,

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ يَوْمَ الدِّينِ
lines.transliteration: Wa ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad yawma al-dīn
lines.english: And bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad on the Day of Judgment,
The day when people will stand before the Lord of the worlds

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
As You saved us through him,

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا كَرَّمْتَنَا بِهِ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad kamā karramtanā bih
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad as You honored us through him,

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا كَثَّرْتَنَا بِهِ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad kamā kaththartanā bih
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad as You increased us through him,

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
As You established us through him,

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
As You revived us through him,

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
As You gave us life through him,

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
As You honored us through him,

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
As You strengthened us through him,
O Allah, bless Muhammad,
As You favored us through him,

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
As You had mercy on us through him,
O Allah, reward our Prophet Muhammad,
May Allah's blessings be upon him and his family,

lines.arabic: أَفْضَلَ مَا أَنْتَ جَازٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ
lines.transliteration: Afaḍḍal mā anta jāzin yawma al-qiyāmah
lines.english: The best that You reward on the Day of Resurrection,
A prophet on behalf of his community,
And a messenger on behalf of those You sent him to,
O Allah, grant him the best share of virtues,
And elevate him to the highest rank of the honored ones,
From the highest degrees,

lines.transliteration: Wa a‘lā ‘illiyyīn fī jannāt wa nahr
lines.english: And the highest levels in the gardens and rivers,

lines.arabic: فِي مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍٍ عِنْدَ مَلِيكٍ مُقْتَدِرٍ
lines.english: In the seat of truth, near a sovereign, omnipotent
O Allah, grant Muhammad until he is satisfied,
And increase him after satisfaction,

lines.transliteration: Wa aj‘alhu akram khalqik minka majlisan
lines.english: And make him the most honored of Your creation in Your presence,
And the greatest in status with You,
And the most abundant in fortune with You,

lines.arabic: فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ أَنْتَ قَاسِمُهُ بَيْنَهُمُ
lines.transliteration: Fī kulli khayrin anta qāsimuhu baynahum
lines.english: In every good that You distribute among them

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ أَوْرِدْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ ذُرّيَّتِهِ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma awrid ‘alayhi min dhurriyyatihi wa azwājih
lines.english: O Allah, present to him from his descendants and his spouses,

lines.transliteration: Wa ahl baytih wa dhawi qarābatih
lines.english: And his family and close relatives,
And his community, those who bring delight to his eyes,
And grant our eyes delight by seeing him,

lines.transliteration: Wa lā tufarriq baynanā wa baynah
lines.english: And do not separate us from him

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

lines.transliteration: Wa a‘ṭihi min al-wasīlat wa al-faḍīlat
lines.english: And grant him the means and the virtue,
And the honor and dignity,
That the closest angels envy,

lines.transliteration: Wa al-nabiyyūn wa al-mursalūn wa al-khalqu ajma‘ūn
lines.english: And the prophets, the messengers, and all creation

lines.transliteration: Allāhumma bayyiḍ wajhah wa a‘li ka‘bah
lines.english: O Allah, illuminate his face and elevate his stature,

lines.transliteration: Wa aflij ḥujjatah wa ajib da‘watah
lines.english: And make his proof clear and answer his prayer,

lines.transliteration: Wa ab‘athhu al-maqām al-maḥmūd alladhī wa‘adtah
lines.english: And raise him to the praised station that You have promised him,
And honor his nearness and increase his gifts,

lines.transliteration: Wa taqabbal shafā‘atah wa a‘ṭihi su’lah
lines.english: And accept his intercession and grant him his request,
And honor his structure and magnify his proof,

lines.transliteration: Wa nawwir nūrah wa awridnā ḥawḍah
lines.english: And brighten his light and bring us to his pool,
And give us to drink from his cup,
And accept the prayer of his community upon him,

lines.arabic: وَاقْصُصْ بِنَا أَثَرهُ وَاسْلُكْ بِنَا سَبِيلَهُ
lines.transliteration: Wa aqṣuṣ binā atharah wa asluk binā sabīlah
lines.english: And trace his steps for us and make us follow his path,
And cause us to die on his religion,
And employ us according to his practice,
And resurrect us on his way,

lines.transliteration: Wa aj‘alnā nadīn bi-dīnih wa nahtadī bi-hudāh
lines.english: And make us adhere to his religion and be guided by his guidance,

lines.transliteration: Wa naqtadī bi-sunnatih wa nakūn min shī‘atih
lines.english: And follow his tradition and be among his followers,

lines.transliteration: Wa mawālih wa awliyā’ih wa aḥibbā’ih
lines.english: And his supporters, friends, and loved ones,

lines.transliteration: Wa khiyār ummatih wa muqaddam zumratih
lines.english: And the best of his community and the leaders of his group,
Under his banner,
We oppose his enemy and befriend his ally,
Until You bring us to him after death,

lines.transliteration: Mawridah ghayra khazāyā wa lā nādimīn
lines.english: At his place, without disgrace and without regret,

lines.transliteration: Wa lā mubaddilīn wa lā nākithīn
lines.english: And not changing or retracting

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ وَأَعْطِ مُحَمَّداً صَلّى اللهُ عَليهِ وَآلِهِ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma wa a‘ṭi Muḥammad ṣallā Allāhu ‘alayh wa ālih
lines.english: O Allah, and grant Muhammad, may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family,
With every nearness, more nearness,
And with every closeness, more closeness,
And with every means, more means,
And with every virtue, more virtue,
And with every intercession, more intercession,
And with every honor, more honor,
And with every good, more good,
And with every dignity, more dignity,

lines.arabic: وَشَفِّعْهُ فِي كُلِّ مِنْ يَشْفَعُ لَهُ
lines.transliteration: Wa shaf‘ihu fī kulli min yashfa‘ lah
lines.english: And make him intercede for all whom he intercedes for,

lines.transliteration: Min ummatih wa ghayruhim min al-umam
lines.english: From his community and others from the nations,
Until no close angel is given,
Nor a sent prophet,
Nor a chosen servant,

lines.arabic: إِلاَّ دُونَ مَا أَنْتَ مُعْطِيهِ مُحَمَّداً
lines.transliteration: Illā dūna mā anta mu‘ṭīhi Muḥammad
lines.english: Except below what You give Muhammad,

lines.arabic: صَلّى اللهُ عَليهِ وَآلِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
lines.transliteration: Ṣallā Allāhu ‘alayh wa ālih yawma al-qiyāmah
lines.english: May Allah's blessings be upon him and his family on the Day of Resurrection

lines.transliteration: Allāhumma wa aj‘alhu al-muqaddama fī al-da‘wah
lines.english: O Allah, and make him the foremost in the call,
And the one who benefits the most in the hereafter,

lines.transliteration: Wa al-munawwah bismi bihi fī al-dunyā wa al-ākhirah
lines.english: And the one praised by name in this world and the hereafter,
In intercession when You manifest Your light,
And the book and the prophets are brought forth,

lines.transliteration: Wa al-ṣiddīqīn wa al-shuhadā’ wa al-ṣāliḥīn
lines.english: And the truthful ones, the martyrs, and the righteous,
And judgment is passed among them in truth,
And they are not wronged,

lines.transliteration: Wa qīla al-ḥamdu lillāhi rabb al-‘ālamīn
lines.english: And it is said, "Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the worlds"
That is the Day of Loss and Gain,
That is the Day of Regret,
That is the Day of Nearness,

lines.arabic: وَذلِكَ يَوْمٌ لا تُسْتَقَالُ فِيهِ الْعَثَرَاتُ
lines.transliteration: Wa dhālika yawmun lā tustaqālu fīhi al-‘atharāt
lines.english: And that is the day when slips are not excused,
And repentance is not accepted,

lines.transliteration: Wa lā yustadraku fīhi mā fāt
lines.english: And what is missed cannot be made up

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma faṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, so bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

lines.transliteration: Wa arḥam Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: And have mercy on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

lines.transliteration: Ka-afḍal mā ṣallayta wa raḥimta wa bārakta
lines.english: As the best You have blessed, had mercy on, and blessed,
Upon Abraham and the family of Abraham,
Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ وَامْنُنْ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma wa amnun ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, and bestow favors upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
As You bestowed favors upon Moses and Aaron

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, bless and grant peace to Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

lines.transliteration: Ka-afḍal mā ṣallayta wa raḥimta wa bārakta
lines.english: As the best You have blessed, had mercy on, and blessed,

lines.arabic: عَلى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَسَلَّمْتَ عَلَى نُوحٍ فِي الْعَالَمِينَ
lines.transliteration: ‘Alā Ibrāhīm wa sallamta ‘alā Nūḥ fī al-‘ālamīn
lines.english: Upon Abraham and granted peace to Noah among the worlds

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
And upon the leaders of the Muslims, the first ones,
From them and the last ones

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
And upon the leader of the Muslims

lines.transliteration: Allāhumma wa iḥfaẓhu min bayna yadayh
lines.english: O Allah, protect him from in front of him,
And from behind him and on his right,
And on his left and from above him,

lines.arabic: وَمِنْ تَحْتِهِ وَافْتَحْ لَهُ فَتْحاً يَسِيراً
lines.transliteration: Wa min taḥtih wa iftaḥ lahū fatḥan yasīrā
lines.english: And from beneath him, and grant him an easy victory,
And grant him a mighty victory,

lines.arabic: واجْعَلْ لَهُ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطَاناً نَصِيراً
lines.transliteration: Wa aj‘al lahū min ladunka sulṭānan naṣīrā
lines.english: And grant him from Your presence an aiding authority
O Allah, hasten the relief of the family of Muhammad,

lines.transliteration: Wa ahlik a‘dā’ahum min al-jinn wa al-ins
lines.english: And destroy their enemies from the jinn and humans

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa ahl baytih
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his household,
And his descendants and his pure spouses,
The good, the pure, the purified ones,
The guided, the rightly-guided ones, not the misled ones,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ الْمُضِلِّينَ الَّذِين أَذْهَبْتَ عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْسِ
lines.transliteration: Wa lā al-muḍillīn alladhīn adhhabt ‘anhum al-rijs
lines.english: Nor the misleaders, those from whom You removed impurity,
And purified them thoroughly

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

lines.arabic: فِي الأوَّلِينَ وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ فِي الآخِرينَ
lines.transliteration: Fī al-awwalīn wa ṣalli ‘alayhim fī al-ākhirīn
lines.english: Among the first ones, and bless them among the last ones,
And bless them in the highest assembly,
And bless them forever and ever,

lines.arabic: صَلاةً لاَ مُنْتَهى لَهَا وَلاَ أَمَدَ
lines.transliteration: Ṣalātan lā muntahā lahā wa lā amad
lines.english: A prayer that has no end and no limit,

lines.arabic: دُونَ رِضَاكَ آمِينَ آمِينَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِين
lines.transliteration: Dūna riḍāk amīn amīn rabb al-‘ālamīn
lines.english: Without Your pleasure, Ameen, Ameen, Lord of the worlds

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ الْعَنْ الَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوا دِينَكَ وَكِتَابَكَ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma al‘an alladhīna baddalū dīnak wa kitābak
lines.english: O Allah, curse those who changed Your religion and Your book,
And altered the tradition of Your Prophet, peace be upon him,
And removed the truth from its place

lines.arabic: أَلْفَيْ أَلْفَ لَعْنَةٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ غَيْرَ مُؤْتَلِفَةٍ
lines.transliteration: Alfay alf la‘nah mukhtalifah ghayr mu’talifah
lines.english: A thousand thousand different curses, not united,

lines.transliteration: Wa al‘anhum alfay alf la‘nah mu’talifah
lines.english: And curse them with a thousand thousand united curses,

lines.transliteration: Ghayr mukhtalifah wa al‘an ashyā‘ahum wa atbā‘ahum
lines.english: Not different, and curse their supporters and followers,

lines.arabic: وَمَنْ رَضِي بِفِعَالِهِمْ مِنَ الأَوَّلِينَ وَالآخِرِينَ
lines.transliteration: Wa man raḍī bi-fi‘ālihimm min al-awwalīn wa al-ākhirīn
lines.english: And those who were pleased with their actions from the first and the last
O Allah, the Creator of the heavens,

lines.transliteration: Wa dāḥī al-madḥuwāt wa qāṣim al-jabābirah
lines.english: And the One who expands the earth and crushes the tyrants,

lines.transliteration: Wa raḥmān al-dunyā wa al-ākhirah wa raḥīmahuma
lines.english: The Most Merciful of this world and the hereafter and their Compassionate,

lines.arabic: تُعْطِي مِنْهُما مَا تَشَاءُ وَتَمْنَعُ مَا تَشَاءُ
lines.transliteration: Tu‘ṭī minhumā mā tashā’u wa tamna‘u mā tashā’
lines.english: You give from them what You will and withhold what You will,

lines.transliteration: As’aluka bi-nūr wajhik wa bi-ḥaqq Muḥammad
lines.english: I ask You by the light of Your face and by the right of Muhammad,

lines.arabic: صَلّى اللهُ عَليهِ وَآلِهِ أَعْطِ مُحَمَّداً حَتّى يَرْضى
lines.transliteration: Ṣallā Allāhu ‘alayh wa ālih a‘ṭi Muḥammad ḥattā yarḍā
lines.english: May Allah’s blessings be upon him and his family, grant Muhammad until he is satisfied,
And grant him the highest means

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ مُحَمَّداً فِي الْسَّابِقينَ غَايَتَهُ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma aj‘al Muḥammad fī al-sābiqīn ghāyatih
lines.english: O Allah, make Muhammad's goal among the foremost,
And his honor among the chosen ones,
And his mention among the high ones,
And settle him in the highest chambers of paradise,

lines.arabic: فِي الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي لاَ تَفُوقُهَا دَرَجَةٌ
lines.transliteration: Fī al-jannah allatī lā tafūquhā darajah
lines.english: In the paradise that no degree surpasses,
And nothing excels it

lines.transliteration: Allāhumma bayyiḍ wajhah wa aḍi’ nūrah
lines.english: O Allah, illuminate his face and brighten his light,
And be his protector

lines.transliteration: Allāhumma aj‘al Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, make Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,

lines.arabic: أَوَّلَ قَارعٍ لِبَابِ الْجَنَّةِ وَأَوَّلَ دَاخِلٍ
lines.transliteration: Awwal qāri‘ libāb al-jannah wa awwal dākhil
lines.english: The first to knock on the door of paradise and the first to enter,

lines.transliteration: Wa awwal shāfi‘ wa awwal mushaffa‘
lines.english: And the first intercessor and the first whose intercession is accepted

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma ṣalli ‘alā Muḥammad wa āl Muḥammad
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad,
The leaders, the masters, the sufficient, the noble elders,
The mighty leaders,

lines.arabic: اللُّيُوثِ الأَبْطَالِ عِصْمَةٍ لِمَنِ اعْتَصَمَ بِهِمْ
lines.english: The brave lions, a protection for those who seek refuge in them,
And a sanctuary for those who seek shelter with them,

lines.transliteration: Wa al-kahf al-ḥaṣīn wa al-fulk al-jāriyah
lines.english: The secure cave and the running ship,
In the overwhelming depths,
And whoever turns away from them is a renegade, and whoever lags behind them,

lines.arabic: وَاللَّازِمُ لَهُمْ لاَحِقٌ وَرِمَاحُكَ فِي أَرْضِكَ
lines.transliteration: Wa al-lāzim lahum lāḥiq wa rimāḥuk fī arḍik
lines.english: And whoever adheres to them will catch up, and Your spears are in Your land,
And bless Your servants in Your land,
Those whom You saved from destruction,
And illuminated through them from the darkness,
The tree of prophethood and the place of the message,

lines.transliteration: Wa mukhtalaf al-malā’ikah wa ma‘din al-‘ilm
lines.english: The frequenting place of angels and the source of knowledge,
May Allah's blessings be upon him and all of them,
Ameen, Ameen, Lord of the worlds

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إِنّي أَسْأَلُكَ مَسْألَةَ الْمِسْكِينِ الْمُسْتَكِينِ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’aluka mas’alat al-miskīn al-mustakīn
lines.english: O Allah, I ask You with the request of the poor, the humble,

lines.transliteration: Wa abtaghī ilayk ibtighā’ al-bā’is al-faqīr
lines.english: And I seek You like the destitute, the needy,
And I humble myself to You with the humility of the weak,

lines.transliteration: Wa abtahil ilayk ibtihāl al-mudhnib al-khāṭi’
lines.english: And I implore You with the imploration of the sinful, the wrongdoer,
The request of one whose soul has submitted to You,

lines.arabic: وَرَغَمَ لَكَ أَنْفُهُ وَسَقَطَتْ لَكَ نَاصِيَتُهُ
lines.transliteration: Wa raghma lak anfuḥ wa saqatat lak nāṣiyatuh
lines.english: And whose nose has been humbled to You, and whose forehead has fallen to You,

lines.arabic: وَانْهَمَلَتْ لَكَ دُمُوعُهُ وَفَاضَتْ لَكَ عَبْرَتُهُ
lines.transliteration: Wa inhamalat lak dumū‘uh wa fāḍat lak ‘abratuh
lines.english: And whose tears have flowed for You, and whose weeping has overflowed for You,

lines.transliteration: Wa a‘tarafa bi-khaṭī’atih wa qallat ‘anhu ḥīlatuh
lines.english: And who has confessed his sin and whose strength has diminished,
And his sins have overwhelmed him

lines.arabic: أَسْأَلُكَ الصَّلاَةَ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ أَوَّلاً
lines.transliteration: As’aluka al-ṣalāt ‘alā Muḥammad wa ālih awwalan
lines.english: I ask You to bless Muhammad and his family, firstly,

lines.transliteration: Wa ākhiran wa as’aluka ḥusn al-ma‘īshah
lines.english: And lastly, and I ask You for a good life,

lines.arabic: مَا أَبْقَيِتَنِي مَعِيشةً أَقْوى بِهَا فِي جَمِيعِ حَالاَتِي
lines.transliteration: Mā abqaytanī ma‘īshatan aqwā bihā fī jamī‘ ḥālātī
lines.english: As long as You keep me alive, a life by which I can endure in all my situations,
