lines.arabic: وَأَتَوَصَّلُ بِهَا فِي الدُّنْيَا إِلى آخِرَتِي
lines.transliteration: Wa atawassalu bihā fī al-dunyā ilā ākhiratī
lines.english: And by which I can reach my hereafter in this world,
With Your pardon, so that I do not become arrogant,
And do not withhold from me, so that I become miserable,

lines.arabic: وَأَعْطِنِي مِنْ ذلِكَ غِنىً عَنْ جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ
lines.transliteration: Wa a‘ṭinī min dhālik ghinā ‘an jamī‘ khalqik
lines.english: And grant me from that, sufficiency away from all Your creation,
And make it reach Your pleasure,
And do not make this world a prison for me,
And do not make its departure a sadness for me,
Take me out of it and from its trials,
Pleased with me, and my deeds accepted in it,

lines.transliteration: Ilā dār al-ḥayawān wa masākin al-akhyār
lines.english: To the abode of life and the dwellings of the righteous

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ إِنّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَزْلِهَا
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma innī a‘ūdhu bika min azalihā
lines.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from its vanishing,

lines.transliteration: Wa zilzālihā wa saṭawāt sulṭānihā wa salāṭīnihā
lines.english: And its shaking, and the tyranny of its rulers and authorities,

lines.arabic: وَشَرِّ شَيْطَانِهَا وَبَغْي مَنْ بَغى عَلَيَّ فِيهَا
lines.transliteration: Wa sharr shayṭānihā wa baghy man baghā ‘alayy fīhā
lines.english: And the evil of its devil, and the aggression of those who oppress me in it
O Allah, whoever intends me with harm, intend him with harm,
And whoever plots against me, plot against him,
And blind the eyes of the disbelievers,
And protect me from that with tranquility,
And clothe me with Your impenetrable armor,
And place me in Your complete protection,

lines.arabic: وَأَصْلِحْ حَالِي وَبَارِكْ لِي فِي أَهْلي
lines.transliteration: Wa aṣliḥ ḥālī wa bārik lī fī ahlī
lines.english: And rectify my condition and bless me in my family,

lines.transliteration: Wa mālī wa waladī wa khuzānatī
lines.english: And my wealth, my children, and my possessions,

lines.transliteration: Wa man aḥbabtu fīk wa aḥabbani
lines.english: And those whom I love for Your sake and who love me

lines.arabic: اَللّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدْ قَدَّمْتُ
lines.transliteration: Allāhumma aghfir lī mā qad qaddamt
lines.english: O Allah, forgive me for what I have sent forth,

lines.arabic: وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ
lines.transliteration: Wa mā akhkhart wa mā a‘lantu wa mā asrartu
lines.english: And what I have delayed, what I have declared, and what I have hidden,

lines.transliteration: Wa mā nasītu wa mā ta‘amadt
lines.english: And what I have forgotten and what I have intentionally done
O Allah, You created me as You willed,

lines.arabic: فَأَجْعَلْنِي كَمَا تُحِبُّ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمينَ
lines.transliteration: Fa-aj‘alnī kamā tuḥibb yā arḥam al-rāḥimīn
lines.english: So make me as You love, O Most Merciful of the merciful

title: Salawat after Asr on Friday
description: Recommended Salawaat for after Asr on Friday.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمُّ صَلّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin wa `ajjil farajahum
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and hasten their Relief.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad—
the Successors and the pleased—
with the best of Your blessings,
and confer upon them
with the best of your favors.
And peace be upon them
and upon their souls and bodies;
and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon them.
The blessings of Allah, His angels,
His prophets, His messengers,
and all of His creatures
be upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
And peace be upon him and upon them
and upon their souls and bodies.
So be Allah’s mercy and blessings.

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad
the Successors and the pleased
with the best of Your blessings,
and confer upon them
with the best of your favors.
And peace be upon him and them
and Allah’s mercy and blessings be also upon them.
O Allah, O He Who is the most magnanimous of all those who may grant!
O He Who is the best of all those who are asked!
O He Who is the most Merciful of all those whose mercy may be sought!

lines.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ فِي ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa alihi fi al-awwalina
lines.english: O Allah, send blessings to Muhammad and his Household among the foremost generations,

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin wa alihi fi al-akhirina
lines.english: send blessings to Muhammad and his Household among the last generations,

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ فِي ٱلْمَلأِ ٱلأَعْلَىٰ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin wa alihi fi almala'i al-a`la
lines.english: send blessings to Muhammad and his Household among the Highest Chiefs,

lines.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ فِي ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa salli `ala muhammadin wa alihi fi almursalina
lines.english: and send blessings to Muhammad and his Household among the Messengers.
O Allah, (please) grant Muhammad and his Household
the right of mediation, preference,
honor, loftiness,
and the grand rank.
O Allah, I believed in Muhammad,

lines.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَلَمْ أَرَهُ
lines.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa lam arahu
lines.english: may Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Household, while I have not seen him;
so, do not deprive me of seeing him on the Resurrection Day,
confer upon me with the favor of accompanying him,
cause me to die while I follow his creed,
and allow me to drink from his Pool
a drink that is quenching,
palatable, and pleasant,
after which I will never be thirsty.
Verily, You have power over all things.
O Allah, I believe in Muhammad,

lines.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَلَمْ أَرَهُ
lines.transliteration: salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi wa lam arahu
lines.english: may Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Household, while I have not seen him;
so, (please) show me his face in the gardens of Paradise.
O Allah, convey to Muhammad,
may Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Household,
many greetings and compliments from me.
